_comment: THE GATE — python profile. Security + performance + bug detection on every push: SAST, SCA, secrets, quality (lint+format+type), coverage, perf-smoke, semgrep, container, codeql, zizmor. Action SHAs are pinned; every job has explicit permissions. Installed by github_apply_gate / github_init_project.
name: github-ci-security-python
description: Enterprise-grade python gate: Bandit SAST, pip-audit SCA, gitleaks secrets, Ruff S+B + format + mypy, coverage threshold, perf-smoke, Semgrep, Trivy, CodeQL, zizmor. All jobs SHA-pinned, graceful-skip when a dependency is absent.

variables.name: gitleaks_version
variables.description: Pinned gitleaks release (asset names are versioned — never /latest)

variables.name: codeql_on
variables.description: true/false — include the CodeQL job (free on public repos)

variables.name: coverage_threshold
variables.description: Minimum line coverage enforced on detected packages (enterprise standard)

variables.name: coverage_strict
variables.description: true = no importable package FAILS the coverage job instead of skipping

variables.name: bandit_level
variables.description: Bandit severity flag: lll=HIGH only, ll=MEDIUM+HIGH

variables.name: job_timeout_minutes
variables.description: Per-job timeout budget — hung jobs never burn runner minutes

variables.name: semgrep_config_ref
variables.description: Pinned Semgrep registry config — deterministic findings across pushes

variables.name: license_denylist
variables.description: Comma-separated license IDs that block deployment

variables.name: image_size_budget_mb
variables.description: Docker image size budget (MB) — fails if exceeded

notes: Two-speed gate: fast-checks.yml (every push, ~30s: lint+syntax+secrets HEAD) + security.yml (PR/push to main only: full deterministic gate) + release-heavy.yml (nightly/tags: deep pass). Branch protection contexts = security.yml jobs only. Docs-only changes skip everything.
